name: 17731-parallelguided-1.3b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One card, one engine.
architecture: PhiForCausalLM, dense, 24 layers, 32 heads (no GQA), head_dim 64, hidden 2048, vocab 51200, fp16, ~1.4B params, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 2.0 req/s, max_duration 240 s, first 25% warmup -- 60 s warm-up and a 180 s measured window.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Prompt exactly 512 tokens, output exactly 128 (ignore_eos, so every sample runs the full 128 steps), `request_format: plain` because this is a base model with no chat template. Every request declares n=3 and the same ArticleCard JSON schema; both are in configs/scenario.json under `spec.backend.sampling_params`.
purpose: A news article card generator producing three JSON variants per 512-token story at two requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 17731-parallelguided-1.3b-1gpu, engine commit
# 4ce64e2df48649c4873f828b8bf71790aa1e56ee. dtype, max-model-len, max-num-seqs,
# max-num-batched-tokens and gpu-memory-utilization are this engine's own defaults, written out
# rather than inherited so a future default cannot drift them.
model: microsoft/phi-1_5
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Chosen, and also what an unset value resolves to on this engine core. HAZARD: the declared
# schema must stay on this backend. Adding multipleOf, any array keyword (uniqueItems, contains,
# minItems, maxItems), string minLength/maxLength/format, or the object keywords makes xgrammar
# reject the schema, and the request is then served by a different backend without an error.
guided-decoding-backend: xgrammar
